lines.t: Oh Lord, sometimes I wonder What it will be like with you
Life made new, life with you
Sky so blue, eternity
When we are together once again
I can't wait for you to come
Can't wait for my life of old to end
I'm ready to be made with you

What it will be like with you

Life with you
